hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A digitorial or factorion number equals the sum of the factorials of its digits.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Check whether any permutation of the digits of n sums to the number represented by that permutation.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import math

def isDigitorialPermutation(n: int) -> bool:
    facts = [math.factorial(i) for i in range(10)]
    digits = [int(d) for d in str(n)]
    fact_sum = sum(facts[d] for d in digits)
    return sorted(str(n)) == sorted(str(fact_sum))
```
